svg.title: Surface motion changes with the seasons
svg.desc: Four matched Oceanic Mollweide panels show seasonal mean historical OSCAR surface-current direction, speed, and directional persistence across one meteorological year. One historical meteorological year from an older OSCAR product. Seasonal means and directional persistence are not a climatology, natural boundary, Lagrangian coherence, full-depth circulation, or heat transport.
svg.metadata: Source: NOAA PIFSC ERDDAP mirror of ESR OSCAR third-degree 5-day archive. Source SHA-256: 94716c1dcf21188c1dad651562ae4c57297bc63bae82a929e9b00b42956e4ea0. svg.text: OSW / MOTION STUDY · M1 SEASONAL PILOT
SURFACE MOTION CHANGES WITH THE SEASONS

seasonal shifts, reversals, and persistent corridors
